units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 4a:7">Ab. Zar. 4ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>פידו</he>, <cite ref="Job 30:24">Job XXX, 24</cite>) <he>אני נפרע מהן כפ׳ של תרנגולת</he> I will collect from them (punish them) as the chicken picks (in small instalments); <cite ref="Job 30:24">ib.</cite> <he>אפי׳ אין ישראל … מעט כפ׳ של תרנגולין וכ׳</he> even if Israel do but small good deeds, as the picking of chickens in the dunghill, I will combine them into one large sum; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 918:4">Yalk. Job 918</cite>.

senses.gloss: (b. h.) (= שֶׁבֶר) misfortune. Pesik. Naḥămu, p. 126ᵇ (ref. to Job l. c.) אין הקב״ה מכה … אלא מביא פ׳ לזו וכ׳ the Lord does not strike a nation and let her sit in despair, but brings misfortune on one and consoles her with another &c.; Yalk. Job l. c.
